# Vendored library

`gsap.min.js` is GSAP 3.15.1 core (https://gsap.com), copied unmodified from the npm package `gsap`. Its header says: "Copyright 2026, GreenSock. All rights reserved. Subject to the terms at https://gsap.com/standard-license." The licence text was not available offline here, so its terms for the client's commercial site have **not** been re-checked: read https://gsap.com/standard-license before this goes on a live site. Self-hosted, so the page makes no third-party request. About 73 KB, 28 KB gzipped.
